title: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine: MicroRNA Discovery and Post-Transcriptional Regulation
titleHi: शरीरक्रिया विज्ञान या चिकित्सा में नोबेल पुरस्कार: माइक्रो-RNA की खोज और जीन नियमन
summary: Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun were awarded the Nobel Prize for the discovery of microRNA and its fundamental role in post-transcriptional gene regulation in multicellular organisms.
content: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are tiny non-coding RNA molecules consisting of approximately 21 to 24 nucleotides that play a pivotal role in gene regulation.
Rather than coding for proteins, miRNAs bind to complementary sequences on target messenger RNA (mRNA) transcripts, either destabilizing the mRNA or repressing its translation by the ribosome.
The initial discovery was made studying the nematode Caenorhabditis elegans, revealing that lin-4 gene produced a small RNA that blocked lin-14 protein synthesis.
This fundamental biological mechanism is conserved across all multicellular organisms, including humans, and is crucial for embryonic development, cellular differentiation, and oncology research.
keyTakeaways: miRNAs are small non-coding regulatory RNAs (21-24 nt)
Regulate gene expression post-transcriptionally by base pairing with target mRNA
Essential for normal cell differentiation and human physiology

title: CRISPR-Cas9 Gene Editing Therapeutics: Sickle Cell & Thalassemia Milestone
titleHi: CRISPR-Cas9 जीन संपादन उपचार: सिकल सेल और थैलेसीमिया में ऐतिहासिक सफलता
summary: Global regulatory approvals (including Casgevy) establish CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing as a clinically validated therapeutic strategy for sickle cell disease and transfusion-dependent beta-thalassemia.
content: Casgevy (exa-cel) utilizes CRISPR-Cas9 to edit a patient's hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) ex vivo.
The gene target is the BCL11A erythroid-specific enhancer, which normally silences the production of fetal hemoglobin (HbF, α₂γ₂) after birth.
By disrupting the BCL11A enhancer, the edit reactivates high levels of fetal hemoglobin in mature red blood cells.
Fetal hemoglobin prevents the polymerization of mutant sickle hemoglobin (HbS), preventing sickling crisis and alleviating chronic severe anemia.
keyTakeaways: Disrupts BCL11A repressor to turn on Fetal Hemoglobin (HbF)
Provides functional cure for severe monogenic hemoglobinopathies
Direct real-world connection to NEET topics on Sickle Cell Anemia and Biotechnology
source: Nature Biotechnology & Global Health Regulatory Bulletins

title: Artificial Intelligence in Modern Diagnostic Medicine and Drug Discovery
titleHi: आधुनिक नैदानिक चिकित्सा और औषधि अनुसंधान में कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI)
summary: Deep learning models (like AlphaFold and automated radiological diagnostic suites) are transforming protein structure prediction, genomic screening, and early cancer detection.
content: Deep learning neural networks can now predict 3D folded structures of nearly all known 200+ million proteins from amino acid sequences alone with atomic accuracy.

In clinical radiology, convolutional neural networks assist clinicians in detecting micro-calcifications on mammograms, early pulmonary nodules on low-dose chest CTs, and diabetic retinopathy on retinal fundus scans.
High-throughput virtual screening algorithms rapidly identify candidate small-molecule inhibitors for previously 'undruggable' biological targets.
keyTakeaways: AlphaFold and transformer architectures accelerate structural biology
AI serves as high-precision assistive tool for clinicians, radiologists, and pathologysts
Connects directly with protein folding and tertiary conformation in NCERT Biomolecules
source: World Health Organization (WHO) Guidance on AI in Health
